items.title: FBI warns ARTEX AI hacking tool is powering global cyberattacks
items.summary: The FBI is warning that hackers are using an AI-powered penetration testing framework called ARTEX to automate cyberattacks against organizations worldwide, including a recent ConnectWise supply-chain breach that compromised Microsoft 365 customer environments. [...]

items.title: TSMC employee data breach linked to cloud provider
items.summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) confirmed that personal employee data has been leaked online after a threat actor put 6.9GB of information allegedly stolen from the company up for auction. [...]

items.title: Pentagon Renames CDAO ‘Super Intelligence Office’
items.summary: The move follows President Trump’s order to replace “artificial intelligence” with “super intelligence” in executive branch communications. The post Pentagon Renames CDAO ‘Super Intelligence Office’ appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Italy Fines Meta €805 Million Over Facebook's Android Gallery Access Without Explicit Consent
items.summary: Meta was fined €805 million in Italy yesterday over a Facebook for Android feature that suggests photos and videos from users' phone galleries for them to post. The Garante, Italy's data protection authority, found that the feature was enabled by default and that the app accessed Italian users' photos, videos, and related metadata without their explicit consent.
